headlines.text: It was 2023 when Danielson & Yuta made a statement, debuting in the main event as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.31 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
Turning the clock back to 2020: FTR vs. SCU (Kaz & Sky) put the AEW World Tag Team Titles on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.80 ? a strong outing. Championship gold always raises the stakes.
Looking back to 2022, when it was the first-ever encounter between Jamie Hayter and Willow Nightingale on Rampage, rated 6.63.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2023, AEW welcomed Jericho & Omega for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.86.
Rewind to 2020, when Darby Allin vs. Ricky Starks met for the very first time, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 7.16 ? a good, competitive contest.
Rewind to 2022, when Rush vs. John Silver headlined Rampage, rated 6.47 in a hard-fought men's division clash.
